# `db/queries/producer-runs.ts`

Provides query helpers for recording and retrieving producer run telemetry in the database. Each run captures execution metadata such as task counts, errors, cost, and duration for a named producer.

---

## Exports

### `recordRun`

Records a single producer run and returns the inserted row.

```ts
import { recordRun } from 'db/queries/producer-runs'
```

#### Signature

```ts
async function recordRun(data: {
  producer: string;
  repo?: string;
  tasksCreated: number;
  duplicatesSkipped: number;
  errors: string[];
  costUsd: number;
  durationMs: number;
}): Promise<{
  id: number;
  createdAt: Date | null;
  repo: string | null;
  costUsd: string | null;
  durationMs: number | null;
  producer: string;
  tasksCreated: number | null;
  duplicatesSkipped: number | null;
  errors: unknown;
}>
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data.producer` | `string` | Yes | Identifier for the producer that performed the run. |
| `data.repo` | `string` | No | Repository associated with the run, if applicable. |
| `data.tasksCreated` | `number` | Yes | Number of tasks created during the run. |
| `data.duplicatesSkipped` | `number` | Yes | Number of duplicate tasks skipped during the run. |
| `data.errors` | `string[]` | Yes | List of error messages encountered during the run. |
| `data.costUsd` | `number` | Yes | Monetary cost of the run in US dollars. |
| `data.durationMs` | `number` | Yes | Total run duration in milliseconds. |

#### Returns

`Promise` that resolves to the inserted row with the following shape:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | `number` | Auto-assigned identifier for the run record. |
| `createdAt` | `Date \| null` | Timestamp when the record was inserted. |
| `repo` | `string \| null` | Repository associated with the run. |
| `costUsd` | `string \| null` | Cost in USD, returned as a string (database numeric type). |
| `durationMs` | `number \| null` | Run duration in milliseconds. |
| `producer` | `string` | Producer identifier. |
| `tasksCreated` | `number \| null` | Number of tasks created. |
| `duplicatesSkipped` | `number \| null` | Number of duplicates skipped. |
| `errors` | `unknown` | Error data as stored in the database. |

#### Example

```ts
import { recordRun } from 'db/queries/producer-runs'

const run = await recordRun({
  producer: 'issue-scraper',
  repo: 'org/repo',
  tasksCreated: 42,
  duplicatesSkipped: 3,
  errors: [],
  costUsd: 0.005,
  durationMs: 1200,
})

console.log(run.id)        // e.g. 17
console.log(run.createdAt) // e.g. 2024-01-15T10:30:00.000Z
```

---

### `listRecent`

Returns recent runs for a producer ordered by `createdAt` descending.

```ts
import { listRecent } from 'db/queries/producer-runs'
```

#### Signature

```ts
async function listRecent(
  producer: string,
  limit?: number,
): Promise<{
  id: number;
  createdAt: Date | null;
  repo: string | null;
  costUsd: string | null;
  durationMs: number | null;
  producer: string;
  tasksCreated: number | null;
  duplicatesSkipped: number | null;
  errors: unknown;
}[]>
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `producer` | `string` | Yes | Identifier for the producer whose runs should be retrieved. |
| `limit` | `number` | No | Maximum number of runs to return. Defaults to implementation-defined value when omitted. |

#### Returns

`Promise` that resolves to an array of run records. Each element has the following shape:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | `number` | Identifier for the run record. |
| `createdAt` | `Date \| null` | Timestamp when the record was inserted. |
| `repo` | `string \| null` | Repository associated with the run. |
| `costUsd` | `string \| null` | Cost in USD, returned as a string (database numeric type). |
| `durationMs` | `number \| null` | Run duration in milliseconds. |
| `producer` | `string` | Producer identifier. |
| `tasksCreated` | `number \| null` | Number of tasks created. |
| `duplicatesSkipped` | `number \| null` | Number of duplicates skipped. |
| `errors` | `unknown` | Error data as stored in the database. |

Results are ordered by `createdAt` descending (most recent first).

#### Example

```ts
import { listRecent } from 'db/queries/producer-runs'

// Retrieve the 10 most recent runs for 'issue-scraper'
const runs = await listRecent('issue-scraper', 10)

for (const run of runs) {
  console.log(run.id, run.createdAt, run.tasksCreated)
}

// Omit limit to use the default
const allRecent = await listRecent('issue-scraper')
```
